faq.a: Bilyaminu is associated with the Arabic form بِنْيَامِين, whose core sense is bilyaminu; benjamin (hausa form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Bilyaminu?
faq.a: Bilyaminu is associated with Arabic. Bilyaminu is the Hausa form of Arabic بِنْيَامِين (Binyāmīn), the name Benjamin.
Yes — the underlying form بِنْيَامِين is Arabic.
Bilyaminu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Bilyaminu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Binyāmīn is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Bilyaminu, bilyaminu. Script forms are بنيامين, بنیامین, بِنْيَامِين, बिल्यामीन.
